name: Chapter Route - Longest Chapter Name Wraps
description: The chapter whose name is longest once the organisation is called Harvard Alumni in Tech. The hero title is the org name plus the city, so its length is content-driven rather than viewport-driven, and this is the entry that proves the title stays inside the viewport: it wraps onto a second line at a natural break instead of running off both edges the way a fixed size with nowrap did. Every other chapter fits on one line with the rules flanking it, so this is the boundary case for that treatment, not a duplicate of them.
